sources.title: Seed 2.0 Official Launch
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The February 14 launch distinguishes three differently sized general-purpose models (Pro/Lite/Mini) and a dedicated Code model, but publishes no Code total or active count and identifies no publicly sized base. Performance and specialization are not a parameter-bearing lineage statement.

sources.title: Model list
sources.evidence: Exact doubao-seed-2-0-code-preview-260215 row lists 256k context, 224k input, 128k output and thinking, text generation, visual understanding, and function calling. Listed as approaching retirement; documentation does not establish endpoint operation.

sources.title: Deep thinking
sources.evidence: Exact Code preview revision supports enabled (default) and disabled thinking, and returning original reasoning content in tool-calling conversations. Accessed indexed content; direct web fetch timed out.

sources.title: Video understanding
sources.evidence: Supported models are explicitly the visual-understanding list, which includes Code. Responses and Chat APIs accept videos. The token-budget explanation uses 80k = 81920 = 80 × 1024. Full HTML accessed directly after web-parser timeout.

sources.title: Seed2.0 official repository
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The official repository describes the Pro/Lite/Mini/Code lineup and API cookbooks, without numeric size or named-base mapping for Code. No parameter or activation table is supplied; the repository code license is not a model-weight release.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Officially Released: Advancing AI Productivity
sources.evidence: Opened October 27 as a later first-party disclosure check. The June 23 release discusses improved general-agent, coding and multimodal capabilities. It supplies no retrospective Code count or named, sized base relationship.

sources.title: TheRouter Seed2.0 Code listing - lineage lead resolution
sources.evidence: Opened October 27 to resolve a fresh search lead asserting fine-tuning of a generic Seed2.0 base. The page supplies no count or first-party sized-checkpoint mapping; its cited official launch identifies Code specialization only. Its displayed coding-score claims are not parameter counts and the current fact table acknowledges no exact Code scores. No technical catalog value is based on this secondary claim.

sources.label: Seed2.1 Officially Released: Advancing AI Productivity

patch.notes: Official API revision: doubao-seed-2-0-code-preview-260215. Earliest documented release: 2026-02-14. Volcano Engine documents 256k context (represented as nominal decimal 256000), 224k maximum input, and 128k maximum output. An exact 262144-token context boundary is not established. The exact Code revision is marked as approaching retirement; no endpoint availability test was performed. Nominal total and active counts remain undisclosed; coding specialization does not establish a publicly sized base. Architecture also remains undisclosed.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains null/undisclosed total and active counts after fresh launch, Coding Plan, repository, original/later-card and English/Chinese count/lineage checks. Code specialization is established, but no nominal size or publicly sized base mapping was found. The secondary fine-tuning claim supplies neither. All unrelated field assessments and existing context/release precision are preserved.
